title: Add a visual inventory-aging report field designer
description: On the existing stock-aging report page, an inventory user chooses finite ERP-135 fields, warehouse/product/as-of-date filters, and previews the current authorized page. Keep the existing static report available; use only the catalog, never free-form SQL. Show unknown age, unknown cost and CNY cost currency explicitly, preserve fixed bucket order, and offer selected-column current-page CSV with formula-leading text escaped. Missing permission and network/validation failures fail visibly; existing HTTP audit records read-only requests. Development only: no migration, production SQL, real database execution, writes, secret/.env change or deployment. Verify Node UI tests and safe build/test; no real-browser acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Stock-aging page opens finite field chooser and warehouse/product/as-of-date filters from the existing controls; preview sends only allowlisted fields and bounded page request to ERP-135.
Preview renders selected columns, fixed age buckets, unknown-age/unknown-cost and CNY evidence safely, with loading, empty, authorization and network states.
Selected-column current-page CSV preserves unknown values and escapes spreadsheet formula-leading text; Node tests cover selection, page cap, rendering, CSV and failures; document workflow.
